reference.pathophysiology: Polyuria-polydipsia loss with ketotic breath names T1DM for basal-bolus teaching with sick-day ketone rules while hyperglycaemia-ketosis-acidosis names DKA for slow fluids then insulin with potassium-cerebral watches; advanced bone-age with breast-testes sorts precocious for GnRH pause with tumour hunts, and family-tempo with karyotype sorts delayed for timed induction.
additionalDifferentials: T1DM versus T2DM versus MODY by weight antibodies and family
DKA versus HHS versus lactic by osmolarity ketones and lactate
Central versus peripheral versus delayed by GnRH bone-age and karyotype
